canonical_orientation: candidate causal source -> incident affected entity/effect

predicates.reason: Attachment meaning spans host, network, and cloud domains; V1 has no measured uniform causal rule.
known_limitations: Provider domains require separate evaluation before traversal is enabled.

predicates.reason: A changed destination may affect its caller.
known_limitations: Declared and observed calls retain their original TC-2 provenance quality.

predicates.reason: Shared scope is not operational source-to-effect evidence.
known_limitations: Containment remains available as topology context but never causal relevance.

predicates.reason: A changed dependency may affect its dependent.
known_limitations: Current TC-2 coverage is primarily declared Kubernetes dependency annotations.

predicates.reason: A resource mutation may affect its explicitly exposed endpoint.
known_limitations: This is endpoint lineage, not proof of observed traffic failure.

predicates.reason: A controller or owner mutation may affect an owned runtime descendant.
known_limitations: Reverse traversal and sibling fan-out are forbidden.

predicates.reason: An explicit producer edge carries source-to-artifact lineage.
known_limitations: Mutable tags and inferred producer edges retain their TC-2 limitations.

predicates.tc2_direction: intended control -> protected object, with documented AWS inconsistency
predicates.reason: The frozen TC-2 contract documents provider direction inconsistency.
known_limitations: Requires a future provider-specific semantic migration and evaluation.

predicates.reason: V1 has no measured DNS causal relevance scenario.
known_limitations: Topo does not actively prove DNS resolution behavior.

predicates.reason: Static routing alone does not establish incident causality.
known_limitations: A future measured conditional evaluator may enable a bounded subset.

predicates.reason: Forward host/controller-to-runtime lineage is defensible and cannot reverse-fan to siblings.
known_limitations: The predicate covers both ownership-like and hosting semantics and ranks below pure ownership.

predicates.reason: Selector membership alone does not establish causal impact.
known_limitations: CR-1 does not duplicate the BR-1 Service aggregate evaluator.

predicates.reason: An observed trigger carries source-to-workflow lineage.
known_limitations: TC-2 marks provider coverage implemented but not golden-tested.

predicates.reason: An artifact mutation may affect an explicit runtime consumer.
known_limitations: The relationship does not upgrade mutable artifact identity or provenance.
